steps.en: OCMS has a connection set up to SPINE
steps.why_en: No SPINE connection or settings exist anywhere in the code.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada koneksi atau pengaturan SPINE di code.

steps.en: OCMS picks which court cases to send
steps.id: OCMS memilih kasus pengadilan yang dikirim
steps.why_en: Court data is only served to another system on request; nothing picks cases for SPINE.
steps.why_id: Data pengadilan hanya dilayani ke sistem lain saat diminta; tidak ada pemilihan kasus untuk SPINE.

steps.en: The court case details are sent to SPINE
steps.id: Detail kasus pengadilan dikirim ke SPINE
steps.why_en: No job, schedule or manual trigger sends anything to SPINE.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada job, jadwal, atau trigger manual yang mengirim ke SPINE.

steps.en: SPINE replies are handled and sent cases are recorded
steps.id: Balasan SPINE diproses dan kasus terkirim dicatat
steps.why_en: No reply handling or record of sent cases exists for SPINE.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pemrosesan balasan atau catatan kasus terkirim untuk SPINE.
